svg.title: Battery Storage Land Lease Screening Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-battery-storage-land-lease-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Battery Storage Land Lease Screening Roadmap; subtitle: A grid-proximity play: acreage, terrain, substation capacity, then terms; caption: LandGate wants 2 to 15 acres next to a substation or under half a mile away, on leases of 20 to 30 years with upgrade rights.; assumptions note: Week labels order the checks; practitioners did not state durations. Thresholds are LandGate's and Land Owl's; Doxy's free check allows 10 screenings a day with a $9.99 map.; note: Sources: LandApp by LandGate (Yes7DTfUfJs @ 00:00:17, 00:00:33, 00:00:51, 00:01:44); Land Owl (yVhfvSQwGRQ @ 00:01:23, 00:02:53).; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Screen the Parcel; deliverable: Shortlist of 2 to 15 acre parcels next to a substation or under half a mile away; gate: Parcel fits acreage and substation distance; week: Week 2; title: Trust the Map Over the Listing; deliverable: Contour lines and soil survey reviewed; 50 feet of fall on 6 to 10% slopes flagged as grading cost; gate: Terrain does not erase the economics; week: Week 3; title: Confirm Capacity With the Utility; deliverable: Utility answer on substation room; zoning confirmed with the county; gate: A substation in service still may have no room for you; week: Week 4; title: Negotiate the Lease; deliverable: 20 to 30 year term with periodic upgrade rights, informed by state renewable incentives; gate: Owner knows the incentives before the developer call
